Synopsis:
Oracle's Executive Chairman Larry Ellison cancelled a plan to sell 50 million shares, announced just one day prior. Oracle is pursuing aggressive capital raises ($45-50bn in 2026) to fund cloud/AI infrastructure expansion. Near-term concerns persist around cash flow recovery and debt-fuelled spending, despite a strong revenue backlog and upbeat Q1 earnings.
